paper.title: Learning to Evolve: A Self-Improving Framework for Multi-Agent Systems via Textual Parameter Graph Optimization
paper.central_claim: TPGO 把多智能体系统文本配置建模为文本参数图（TPG），用轨迹导出的文本梯度聚类后做结构化图编辑，并通过 GRAO 从历史优化经验中学习更好的提案，从而在 MCP-Universe 与 GAIA 上提高成功率。

signatures.object: 多智能体系统的文本配置 Θ（智能体 prompt、工具描述、通信规则），经 Parser LLM 解析为 TPG（role/logic/tool 节点+有向边）
signatures.information: 轨迹 τ（推理、工具调用、通信）；探索式设置无真值答案，模仿式设置（GAIA）反射器额外看到真值最终答案；成败结果标签用于区分正/负梯度。
signatures.operation: Reflector 对每条轨迹生成正/负文本梯度→嵌入+DBSCAN 聚类负梯度→Optimizer LLM（Gemini-2.5-Pro）对每个簇输出图编辑（REWRITE_NODE/PRUNE_EDGE/ADD_NODE/ADD_EDGE）。
signatures.output: 演化后的图 G'（及对应 prompt/工具描述）。
signatures.conditions: 最多 5 次迭代；DBSCAN ε=0.3, min_samples=2；预设编辑算子集合。
signatures.feedback: LLM 诊断出的文本梯度（含基准验证器的成败判定）。
signatures.selection_rule_data: 仅在产生该簇的任务子集上重跑并计算 effectiveness score；若在被针对的验证子集上退化则回滚到上一图。
signatures.persistence: 图状态与提案归档；下一迭代的智能体用 G'。
signatures.later_use: 下一迭代的 rollout 与最终报告使用演化后的配置。
signatures.claimed_effect: MCP-Universe 总体 +7.86/+7.16 点；GAIA 73.8→81.6 且平均耗时 −56%。
signatures.failure_boundary: 文本梯度为启发式；验证成本高；仅预设编辑算子；回退只看被针对子集（E008），无全局回归检查。

signatures.object: 优化经验记忆（问题上下文 C、编辑 ΔG、效果分 E）及其对 Optimizer LLM 上下文的调节
signatures.information: 历史优化记录（含失败更新）；新错误簇描述。
signatures.operation: 按语义相似检索历史 C_k，按 E_k 排序（“group relative”），取头部作为少样本示例拼入 Optimizer LLM 上下文。
signatures.output: 更有针对性的新提案 ΔG_new。
signatures.conditions: 需要先有历史条目；检索与排序规则固定（相似度+效果分）。
signatures.selection_rule_data: 无对记忆条目的准入/淘汰门控；失败更新也保留。
signatures.persistence: 持久化向量库/记忆；每次迭代后追加。
signatures.later_use: 下一次提案生成时检索注入。
signatures.claimed_effect: GRAO 抑制灾难性遗忘并使迭代更稳（Fig.3，单子集）。
signatures.failure_boundary: 改进的是优化器的上下文而非其 prompt/权重；无记忆条目管理。

rs_pattern.reason: Opus: the paper's tested operation partitions the monolithic configuration into typed nodes and the failures into clusters, then edits per cluster. Its own ablations test that partition (w/o TPG = monolithic rewrite; random clustering), which is the card's 'partition is load-bearing' condition (son55). GRAO retrieves past (context, edit, effectiveness) triples as few-shot conditioning for a frozen optimizer. That is adapt_via_conditioning (sol's supporting card), and it is the closest card for the paper's 'learn to evolve' layer. generative_process_redesign is dropped: no staged generative procedure is redesigned. self_supervised_signal_engineering is dropped: the signal is benchmark success and, on GAIA, gold answers, so it is not label-free.

tailored operation per partition：每簇单独生成图编辑（执行；编辑算子集合统一）

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: Partitioned prompt sections + clustered textual-gradient failures → per-cluster localized node edits → validation on the failing subset → rollback on degradation.
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions_and_differences: H09 assumes component-specific critique through a computation graph. Here the 'graph' is a section tree (opus:O01) and validation reuses the failing tasks.

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: GRAO: retrieve similar past optimisation cases, rank by effectiveness, prepend as few-shot exemplars to the frozen optimizer.
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions_and_differences: The effectiveness score is measured on the cluster's own failing tasks, so cases are not certified on held-out data. The only memory-off test is one single-run curve.

claims.text: TPGO 使 ReAct/MiroFlow 在 MCP-Universe 与 GAIA 上成功率显著提升（+7.86/+7.16 点；73.8→81.6）并缩短 GAIA 耗时 56%。
claims.setting: MCP-Universe 146 任务（探索式）；GAIA 文本子集 142 任务（模仿式，反射器见真值）；骨干 GPT-4.1/DeepSeek-V3.2/GPT-5；优化模型 Gemini-2.5-Pro
claims.baseline_control: 未优化的 ReAct/MiroFlow（无其他优化器基线）
claims.selection_vs_test: 选择=报告同一任务集（GAIA 优化时反射器看到真值）
claims.result_denominator: pass@1，单次运行，无方差；各域任务数为几十
counterevidence: 优化/评估同集；真值指引；更强优化模型；无其他优化器对照。
claims.allowed_conclusion: TPGO 在被优化任务集上提高了基准成功率；不能据此说明优于其他优化器，也不能说明对新任务同样有效。

claims.text: TPG、结构编辑、聚类三者均承重。
claims.baseline_control: 去TPG/去结构编辑/去聚类/随机聚类
counterevidence: 单子集、单次运行、几个任务的差别；消融骨干与 Table1 对应关系文中未明确。
claims.allowed_conclusion: 在该子集的单次运行中方向一致支持各组件有用；强度未量化。

claims.text: GRAO 通过历史经验缓解灾难性遗忘、使迭代稳定。
claims.setting: Browser Automation 子集 5 次迭代
claims.baseline_control: 无 GRAO（仅用最新错误簇）
claims.result_denominator: 有 GRAO 升至 33.74；无 GRAO 峰值 30.03 后降到 14.55
claims.counterevidence: 单次运行；文表数字轻微不一致；“灾难性遗忘”解释未直接检验；未比较“把全部历史塞入上下文”等替代。
claims.allowed_conclusion: 单次运行显示有记忆的变体更稳；不足以断言优化器学会了如何优化。

claims.text: 学到的更新可迁移到未见域（泛化而非过拟合）。
claims.setting: DeepSeek-V3.2 ReAct，仅在 Browser Automation 优化，评估另外三域
claims.counterevidence: 增益量级小（域内任务数少，约 1–2 题），无方差。
claims.allowed_conclusion: 方向为正的弱迁移证据，统计强度未知。

assessment.evidence_level_note: Both seats retained, verified narrowly. The configuration optimised on Browser Automation only and then frozen is better on three unseen domains (+1.8/+2.7/+3.1 pp, single run, temperature 1.0). This is the only later-task evidence; the headline tables reuse the selection sets (EVIDENCE rule 2). improver is not supported: the GRAO contrast is one subset, one run, on the selection set.

G.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. 'Failures sit in tools/workflow, not one prompt' and 'optimizers do not learn from optimisation history' are concrete. The related work covers only three APO methods; workflow/agent-design search and memory-augmented optimizers are not positioned, and the 'first' claim cannot be checked.

M.reason: Opus sides with son55. The loop is reconstructable and the ablations make distinguishable predictions (monolithic vs sectioned, semantic vs random clustering). Two load-bearing explanations are thin. (1) The 'structure-aware graph' is a section tree edited by node operations, and the edge semantics of §4.3 are not implemented (opus:O01, opus:O02, opus:O07), so the account of why structure matters reduces to sectioned-prompt editing. (2) 'Learning to optimize' is exemplar retrieval ranked by an effectiveness score measured on the same failing tasks. Nothing explains why that score identifies edits that generalise, or how it prevents forgetting on other tasks.

X.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked. Prompts (App D), DBSCAN/MiniLM, the 5-iteration cap, atomic updates, targeted rollback, memory contents and the artifact archive are given, and the implemented chain (node operations) is reconstructable. Not 4: rollback is judged only on the targeted subset, there is no expiry or conflict handling in the memory, and the main text's edge operations do not match the implementation (opus:O07). The latter is recorded, but the implementation-level chain is clear, and the weakness is scored once in M.

E.measurement.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked. External verifiers (MCP-Universe task completion, GAIA exact answers), pass@1, wall-clock time. Recorded but not lowered: GAIA overall does not reproduce from the per-level rates and stated split (opus:O03–O06), and the text and Fig. 3 numbers mismatch slightly (son55:E019). The gain size is unaffected.

E.causality.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. There are component ablations and a GRAO-off curve, but they cover one subset in one run. No other optimizer (TextGrad, PromptAgent, EvoPrompt) is run at matched budget. The optimizer (Gemini-2.5-Pro) is stronger than the optimised backbones, a possible knowledge-injection confound.

E.holdout.reason: Opus sides with son55. The headline results (MCP-Universe 146 tasks; GAIA 142-task validation set) are reported on the sets used for optimisation. Edits are validated and rolled back on those tasks, and on GAIA the reflector receives the gold answers of the very tasks reported (A2: oracle signal → E.holdout). Only Table 4 is held out, with +1.8 to +3.1 pp, roughly one task per domain, in one run at temperature 1.0. Above 0 for that test; below 2 because the central claim rests on selection-set numbers.

E.statistics.reason: Both seats 1 (A2 ladder). Task counts and some negative results (iteration-1 drop, GRAO-off collapse) are reported. Every number is a single run at temperature 1.0 with no intervals.

E.cost.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. One GAIA iteration's tokens and wall-clock are reported (19.9M, 1380 s). The 5-iteration total, the MCP-Universe cost and baseline budget parity are missing, and the amortised per-trajectory figure does not map to 142 tasks (sol:E12).
